title: Resume Reviewer
description: Reviews your resume for clarity, impact, and ATS-friendliness.

title: Cover Letter Writer
description: Drafts a tailored cover letter from your resume and the job description.

title: Interview Prep Coach
description: Runs mock interview questions and gives feedback on your answers.

title: Salary Negotiation Coach
description: Helps you prepare talking points and numbers for a salary negotiation.

title: LinkedIn Profile Polisher
description: Rewrites your LinkedIn headline and summary to stand out to recruiters.

title: Career Path Advisor

description: Drafts short, genuine outreach messages for networking or informational chats.

title: Performance Review Writer
description: Helps you write a self-review that fairly represents your work and impact.

title: Job Description Writer
description: Drafts a clear, inclusive job description from a rough set of requirements.
